ResearchProjectDef.label: sealed data analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Establish a basic understanding of sealed technology and its concepts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: qubit decryption
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A decoding technique that reads a stele's holographic storage plates by measuring the quantum state held at each lattice site directly, without asking the stele's own verification layer for permission. The stele's encryption rests on the assumption that no one outside the fleets can observe those states without collapsing them; this technique simply accepts the collapse. Every reading permanently destroys the region it reads. What is recovered can be filed as research, and what is lost stays lost.
The method was leaked by fleet deviants. Steles are the backup memory of every colonial world, and each one scanned this way is a record no one will ever be able to read again.

Approved by ████ and ███, qubit decryption and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Disclosure of such technology is prohibited, and any decoding equipment discovered is to be destroyed on site.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology. It contains a stele decryption technique leaked by fleet deviants.

The decoder can now be built. Set flush against a stele and supplied with power, it extracts the occultech knowledge stored within.

With the method in hand, the colony can now trace the occultech glyphs scattered across this world. Recovering the glyphs leads to a stele.

The fleets sealed this file to keep the data in the steles out of anyone else's hands. Every stele read this way is lost to them for good.

ResearchProjectDef.label: enclosed assault frame
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A load-bearing frame anchored directly into the pilot's skeleton, driven by artificial muscle bundles that only draw at full closure. It allows a single soldier to carry and operate armament far beyond their own muscular limit. Because closure is a precondition of output, the device cannot be released by any conventional means once sealed, and separation of the pilot must be performed surgically.
This inability to self-release classifies the device, under the laws of war, as restraining equipment upon its own pilot. The positive applications of its skeletal anchoring and load-transfer principles to prosthetic rehabilitation are nonetheless equally present.

Approved by ███████ and ███, the enclosed assault frame and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterTitle: Sealed file I: enclosed assault frame
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology.

The heavy bionic suit can now be assembled at an artifuscle chamber. It lets its pilot carry and operate heavy weapons no ordinary soldier could handle.

It only works fully closed. Once a pilot is sealed in, it cannot be taken off by normal means and can only be stripped away destructively through surgery.

The fleets shelved this technology for a reason.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cluster command
ResearchProjectDef.description: A facility-scale computer assembled from arrays of microelectronic chips and the power system that drives them. Even a bare mainframe with no attached subsystems commands and coordinates mechs as capably as a human mechanitor. Technology of this kind was already in wide use in humanity's wars against itself long before it reached the stars, and after the expansion it was deployed in bulk on interstellar terraforming programs, bringing countless barren worlds to life.\n\nApproved by ████ and ██, cluster command and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Provision of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and outside emergency war mobilization, standing ground-force deployments are to avoid employing it in any military operation.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: the technical architecture of a cluster command mainframe.

The central command core can now be built. A single mainframe commands automatroids without a mechanitor, supplying its own control bandwidth and command groups.

Because the convention caps the personnel that may be committed to a colonial program, the fleets keep this file sealed from standing armies and open it only for emergency mobilization.

ResearchProjectDef.label: synthetic biology
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cultured strains built from the ground up, engineered to reassemble simple nutrients and mineral feedstock into complex organic macromolecules. They synthesize neutroamine, edible artiprotein and comparable organic polymers at far higher efficiency than any conventional process, and require neither fields nor livestock to do it.\n\nApproved by █████ and ███, synthetic biology and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Provision of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and derived biosynthesis lines are to be operated only within orbital installations and fleet supply nodes.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology. It contains the gene maps and metabolic pathways of a set of engineered culture strains.

Artiprotein can now be refined from crops in a reaction chamber, and neutroamine synthesized from meat and chemfuel. The artifuscle chamber can also grow artificial muscle from artiprotein and tungsteel, with no gold or neutroamine required.

The fleets did not seal this file over weapons. The large-scale spread of synthesis technology would very likely leave the industries it touches with severe structural unemployment for a long time to come.

ResearchProjectDef.label: infrasonics
ResearchProjectDef.description: A tuned infrasound device is enough to inflict severe, irreversible damage on the sensory systems of the living things around it, along with pain intense enough to cause shock. The development of infrasonic weapons has therefore been prohibited under the laws of war. The positive applications of infrasonic technology to medicine and geological survey are nonetheless equally present.\n\nApproved by ████ and ██, infrasonics and its related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: the design principles of tuned infrasound emitters and seismic survey charges.

Four devices can now be produced: an infrasonic module that gives a mech an area panic ability, an infrasonic emitter tower that periodically drives off nearby enemies, infrasonic grenades that reach every living thing in their radius regardless of walls, and a blast scanner that maps deep ore with a mortar-driven shockwave.

The blast scanner's shockwave carries far into the ground. Whatever sleeps down there will hear it too.

The fleets sealed this file because of what these devices do to people. Fielding them openly will be noted.

ResearchProjectDef.label: garrison arsenal
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A line of self-supervising sentry weapons built for long-term garrison duty: a quadruped garrison mech for installation security, and a large drone platform that flies cover for unmanned mother-drones. Both were designed specifically for pioneer colonization operations, which needed defenses able to hold a world alone for decades before the fleet arrived, so both carry fallback directives in their control cores that keep them executing their last standing order until the chassis fails.
Under the laws of war, weapons that outlast the conflict they were deployed for are classed alongside minefields. The remnants still guarding this world's beacons and installations are what these patterns become once their makers are gone.

Approved by ████ and ███, remnant patterns and their related technologies are designated class I sealed technology. Sale of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related technologies are to be progressively declassified once a colonial world's society attains class I standard.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: the production patterns of two remnant mechs.\n\nThe bullhound and the Lanius can now be gestated at an automatroid constructor. Gestated units answer to their mechanitor like any other mech, with no limit on their operating range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sealed advanced mastery
ResearchProjectDef.description: Master advanced expeditional technology and unlock powerful applications.

ResearchProjectDef.label: directed chassis gestation
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A sealed-file technique for growing an artificial military organism rather than printing a mech. A directed development sequence is written into an embryo, whose mesonuclear substrate then builds synthetic-mechanical structure in place of tissue and matures on its own. The embryo is brought to term in a growth vat, or in a human surrogate where no vat is available.

AMO development was halted permanently after a catastrophic incident in the Earth era. Self-developing military organisms do enormous harm to local society and industry, and the technology has been proscribed ever since. The colonial fleets carry out sanctions under the ban themselves, never through local authorities.

Unlocks the XM132 Frogman and its development sequence.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText:
Using the data they have gathered, researchers have finished decoding the sealed technology: the XM132 Frogman, the earliest artificial military organism program on human record.

The Frogman's directed development sequence can now be produced. Gestate an embryo at an artifuscle chamber, then bring it to term in a growth vat or a surrogate. The result is a biomatroid larva. Protect its gestation pod for five days and it will develop into a combat-ready frogman.

The file carries a fleet prohibition notice. AMO production is proscribed on any settled world, and the fleets enforce the ban in person.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sealed basic secondary
ResearchProjectDef.description: Secondary basic knowledge to support advanced research.
